title: wp11_settings.h: no compile-time bounds on MAX_SESSIONS/MAX_SLOTS
description:
wolfp11/wp11_settings.h defines WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SESSIONS (default 8) and WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SLOTS (default 16) with no validation. A user who sets MAX_SESSIONS=0 gets a zero-element global array and a divide-by-zero or always-failing slot lookup. A value like 100000 silently allocates multi-MB BSS.

Add static_assert guards:
  #if WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SESSIONS < 1 || WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SESSIONS > 256
  #error WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SESSIONS must be 1-256
  #endif

Same for MAX_SLOTS. Add comment explaining the range choices.
